description: The system shall allow the partner to consult the list of their clients.
A list of clients with basic data shall be displayed.
The user shall be able to filter the list by different criteria and also sort it.
The user shall be able to select a client and consult the list of locations.
The system shall allow the partner to consult the list of locations of a previously selected client.
A list of locations with their respective players shall be displayed.
The user shall be able to filter the list by different criteria.
The user shall be able to select a player and access the player management view.
The system shall allow the partner to create a new location for a client.
A form shall be displayed to create a new location.
The Google Maps API shall be used to facilitate address search, thereby making it easier to fill out form fields.
The system shall allow the partner to initiate the registration process of a player by scanning the QR code displayed on the screen.
If the QR code has been scanned correctly and is valid, the system shall navigate to the subsequent screens to select the client and location.
Once selected, the user only has to choose the player configuration.
The system shall allow the partner to consult the current status of the different players of their clients.
In the list of a client's locations, information on the current status and the last connection shall be displayed for each player.
The system shall allow the partner to perform different actions on a player in real time.
Buttons for different actions shall be displayed on a player's screen: reboot players, shutdown, force synchronization, and restart playback.
The system shall allow the partner to visualize general information of a player.
In the INFO tab of a player screen, boxes of different categories shall be displayed: general, configuration, preview, and storage.
The system shall allow the partner to visualize advanced information of a player.
In the ADVANCED tab of a player screen, boxes of different categories shall be displayed: actions, screen and orientation, audio, and synchronization.
Each category shall contain information and buttons to perform changes.
The system shall allow the partner to visualize the uptime of a player.
In the UPTIME tab of a player screen, a calendar shall be displayed showing the uptime of each day by hours.
The system shall allow the partner to consult the log history of a player.
In the PLAYLOGS tab of a player screen, a list with playback logs shall be displayed.
Each log shall contain information about the content that has been played.
Logs can be received in real time via sockets.
The system shall allow the partner to edit the configuration of a player.
In the INFO tab of a player screen, inside the general box, there shall be a button to edit the configuration.
The system shall allow the partner to receive push notifications.
If the user has notification permissions enabled, they shall receive push notifications on their device in case of incidents.
The system shall allow the partner to customize push notifications.
The user shall be able to set the types of notifications they want to receive in 3 levels (general, per client, and per player).
The system shall allow the partner to consult a list of received push notifications.
In the NOTIFICATIONS tab, a list of received notifications ordered chronologically shall be displayed.
Read and unread notifications shall be differentiated.
If the user clicks on a notification, it shall lead them to the corresponding player screen.
The system shall allow the partner to edit their profile information.
The user shall be able to modify profile information such as name, profile picture, etc.
The system shall allow the partner to change their password.
The user shall be able to modify their password.
The user must confirm the current password in order to change it.
The password must have a minimum of 8 characters, at least one uppercase letter, at least one number, and one special character.
The system shall allow the partner to change the application language.
The user shall be able to choose between: Catalan, Spanish, English, French, Italian, Portuguese, and German.
The application must be simple to use for any user.
The requirement will be understood as complete when the feedback from test users is good.
The application must always be available to the user.
The requirement will be understood as complete if the service is continuously available.
The application must ensure that user data is confidential and protected from unauthorized access.
The requirement will be understood as complete if communications between the server and the application use the minimum information possible and are authenticated.
The application must be available for mobile devices with iOS and Android systems.
The requirement will be understood as complete if the application is available for both systems and works correctly.
The application must be compatible with different languages: English, French, German, Catalan, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian.
The requirement will be understood as complete if the application is available in the languages specified above.
The application must follow the corporate image of the company.
The requirement will be understood as complete if the application follows the company's image.
